_comment: UNVERIFIED sample (spec 030), shape from learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks: events under "hooks", each a list of matcher groups with their own "hooks" list. Copy to .codex/hooks.json (project) or ~/.codex/hooks.json (user) and fix the paths to this repo's hooks/. timeout must stay above WARDEN_HOOK_TIMEOUT (default 8 s, max 25 s) so AgentWarden's fail-safe is printed before Codex gives up on the hook.
